hero_eyebrow: Free to start · Runs in your browser · Nothing is uploaded
hero_lead: Turn an .xlsx or .xls spreadsheet into a clean, ready-to-share PDF. Everything runs locally — your file is never sent to a server.
drop_sub: or click to browse · XLSX, XLS
footnote: Values and grid layout carry over; colors, charts, and exact cell formatting don't — this is a data-fidelity conversion, not a pixel-perfect one.

how_title: Three steps to a shareable PDF
how_lead: No settings to configure. Drop a file, wait a moment, download.
step1_desc: Drag and drop, or choose from your device. Your file never leaves it.
step2_desc: itdocsy reads every sheet and lays its rows and columns out as a table.
step3_desc: Get a PDF, one section per sheet, ready to view, print, or share anywhere.
